title: Shipbuilding Pre-Hot-Work Gas-Free Certificate Record
description: Evidence model for the pre-hot-work gas-free certificate (Inert-Gas / Cargo / Ballast / Bunker tank atmosphere verification) issued before any welding, cutting, grinding, or other ignition-source work on or near a shipyard tank or compartment. Verifies flammable-vapor LEL is 0%, oxygen is within the 19.5-23.5% safe range, and toxic residuals (benzene, H2S, CO) are below PEL. Distinct from the ship-tank confined-space ENTRY record (which authorizes personnel entry); this record specifically authorizes IGNITION-SOURCE hot work in the certified atmosphere. Korea's HD Hyundai Heavy, Samsung Heavy, and Hanwha Ocean require this certificate per task, consistent with OSHA-KR Art 38 hot-work safety measures and DSSMA Art 5 flammable-vapor handling.

compartment_id.description: Tank or compartment identifier (e.g., 'Hull-1234 No.3 COT-Port', 'Bunker-Tank-Stbd', 'Fore-Peak-Ballast').

lel_percent.description: Lower Explosive Limit (%) reading of the compartment atmosphere. MUST read 0% LEL before any ignition-source work is authorized. Any positive reading invalidates the hot-work permit.

oxygen_percent.description: Oxygen concentration (%) in the compartment. Safe range is 19.5-23.5%. Below 19.5% is asphyxiation risk; above 23.5% is fire-promotion risk.

benzene_ppm.description: Benzene vapor concentration (ppm) — residual aromatic hydrocarbon common in crude/slop/bunker tanks. Korea OSHA-KR PEL = 1 ppm TWA; readings at or above PEL require supplied-air respiratory protection.

h2s_ppm.description: Hydrogen sulfide concentration (ppm) — residual sour-crane / slop-tank toxic gas. Korea OSHA-KR PEL = 10 ppm TWA; 15 ppm STEL; 100 ppm is IDLH.

co_ppm.description: Carbon monoxide concentration (ppm) — residual inert-gas / pyrolysis product. Korea OSHA-KR PEL = 25 ppm TWA.

gas_tester_certification_id.description: Certificate number of the Marine Chemist or Competent Person who performed the atmosphere test (Korea: 한국산업안전보건공단 certified gas-measurement assessor, or classification-society-approved marine chemist).

test_timestamp_iso.description: Atmosphere-measurement timestamp (ISO 8601). Certificate is valid for a maximum of 4 hours from this timestamp per Korea shipyard hot-work procedure; re-test required if exceeded.

hot_work_permit_authorized.description: True if the companion hot-work permit has been countersigned by the shipyard safety officer based on this gas-free certificate.
